message.content: Proposed 3 changes — review the inline preview, then Accept or Reject.

patch.title: Anonymize the manuscript for double-blind review: replace author/affiliation with "Anonymous", remove the institution-identifying acknowledgment, and anonymize the self-citation key/entry in findings.tex and refs.bib.

hunks.oldText: The results use the public Atlas dataset and retain the necessary self-citation \cite{our2023}.
hunks.newText: The results use the public Atlas dataset and retain the necessary citation \cite{anon2023}.
